## Objective
- Build a complete, playable first-person 3D game set in a cozy anime bedroom, with an adult companion, dialogue, voice/text input, and simple character actions.

## Requirements
- Companion appearance: dark-blue shoulder-length hair with bangs, blue cat-ear cap, red off-shoulder sweater, blue pleated skirt, red knee socks with white stripes, expressive large eyes.
- Bedroom includes a white bed with star and orange pillows, desk/monitor, pink-curtained window, rug, and lamp; soft pastel lighting.
- Player can use microphone or text; companion replies with speech and supports sitting, standing, approaching, hugging, dancing, making tea, and joy/sad/shy/surprised emotions.
- Warm, playful, lightly flirtatious adult character; no NSFW; remember player name and prior conversation. Avoid generic greeting/opening lines.
- Clean Montserrat interface, bottom dialogue window, mobile swipe camera and controls.
- Finish the build without clarifying questions; note assumptions briefly at completion.

- Extend the existing Three.js game and UI in place.
- Assistant stated that the existing room/mobile controls would be upgraded with an anime-style companion, requested room props, animated actions, and specific Russian dialogue.

- Replaced `src/scene.js` with an expanded pastel bedroom scene, including bed, pillows, pink curtains, desk/monitor, rug, tea, lamp, and enhanced anime-inspired companion model.

- Build a complete, playable first-person 3D game in a cozy anime bedroom, with an adult companion, dialogue, voice/text input, and simple character actions.
